name: novacrest-skills
description: Claude skills the Novacrest marketing team shares. Add this repo once as a marketplace in Claude, then install any plugin in it.

plugins.name: motion-how-to-video
plugins.description: Make a narrated how-to video of an app flow: real screens, a Claude Motion film, an English ElevenLabs voice under each caption, one MP4.

plugins.name: long-form-video
plugins.description: Make a narrated long-form YouTube video and its shorts: an iceberg, an answers video or an argument. Research, script, ElevenLabs voice, Blueprint-style stills, Higgsfield clips, MP4, shorts and upload text.
